_doc: Story objects of the missing_objects agent (2026-10-08): Sapphire's objects that had no Black 2 sprite. 3D field objects (codes 8192-8194 and 112: b2tools/models_objects.py -> src/objects3d/, installed by patches/objects3d.py) carry "requires_object3d": story.py leaves them out of a build without that patch. Billboards (143 Pichu Doll, 356 cable car) are src/sprites/overworld art (patches/sprites.py). uid = Sapphire's local object id (outdoor maps: 100 + id). Positions: Sapphire's, except the S.S. Tidal (harbors one tile north, Battle Tower and Southern Island one tile south: the hull clear of the dock); Mr. Briney's boat at Dewford is the boat turned bow south (code 112).
